portal_hypertension.title: Rebalanced hemostasis, bleeding and thrombosis in liver disease: a comprehensive review of pathophysiology, management and future perspectives.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝病患者的止血系统表现出复杂的变化，通常被认为会导致出血和血栓形成。 临床提示：然而，目前的证据表明，抗止血变化可以通过同时的促止血变化来补偿，从而导致止血系统重新平衡。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Patients with liver disease exhibit complex changes in the hemostatic system that are often presumed to drive bleeding and thrombosis. Historically, liver disease was considered a bleeding disorder based on thrombocytopenia, prolonged routine coagulation tests, and reports of fulminant bleeding. Present evidence, however, indicates that antihemostatic changes are compensated for by simultaneous prohemostatic changes, resulting in a rebalanced hemostatic system. Further hemostatic changes may be induced by liver disease progression and extrahepatic factors, such as systemic inflammation, acute kidney injury and cardiometabolic diseases. portal_hypertension.title: Diagnostic Pitfalls and Lessons Learned in Portal Hypertension.
portal_hypertension.authors: Mannava A, Liu W, Saab S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：该病例强调了当影像学提示肝硬化时组织学确认的重要性，因为浸润性恶性肿瘤可以模仿肝硬化并产生临床上显着的门静脉高压。 临床提示：非肝硬化性门静脉高压症定义为不存在肝硬化或晚期肝纤维化的门静脉高压症。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Noncirrhotic portal hypertension is defined as portal hypertension in the absence of cirrhosis or advanced hepatic fibrosis. We present an 85-year-old man with recurrent hematemesis, initially presumed to have decompensated cirrhosis based on imaging. However, liver biopsy revealed pseudocirrhosis due to sinusoidal infiltration by metastatic spindle cell malignancy. This case underscores the importance of histological confirmation when imaging suggests cirrhosis, as infiltrative malignancies can mimic cirrhosis and produce clinically significant portal hypertension.
